Référence 5875998
|
Créé le 18 juin 2026
Retour à la liste
Lieu :
1000 - Bruxelles
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Logiciel - Software
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 4 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
Do you want to work with us to help the shift towards a more sustainable world?
Is functional analysis your bread and butter? If so, you might be the Analytical Wizard we need to bring our ambitions to life. As a Functional Analyst, you actively contribute to innovative solutions that benefit millions of clients.
You will help us to deliver the best suited, trusted, compliant and frictionless interaction across the customer journeys.
At this moment, we are looking for several Functional Analysts in, amongst others, one of the following capacities:
Collaborating in the implementation of customer journeys in our Web and mobile applications, across a variety banking products (Payments, Credits, Accounts, Investments, .) and in connection to the bank's backend systems;
Or translating business requirements for individual or corporate banking applications into feasible solutions;
Or fostering interactions between employees and clients using the latest technologies: APIs, distributed environment, cloud-based services.
We are open for candidates with all levels of experience (junior, medior, senior), but a strong motivation and interest in the matter are key!
Your job
As functional analyst, you are part of a cross-functional, Agile team. Together, you design and develop qualitative applications to address the quickly evolving customer needs; an exciting and versatile challenge!
You shape the functional requirements and propose multiple feasible solutions, evaluating the pros and cons of each
You design the chosen solution in detail according to the architectural roadmap and share it with your squad
You provide further clarification and support to the developers
You contribute to the creation and execution of test cases
You create and maintain clear documentation
You provide support during the implementation and post-implementation phase
Profil
Highlight your strengths
You are result- and solution-driven
You are quick to make connections, dare to challenge and strive to continuously improve
You are a problem solver and can work independently
You are the physical embodiment of the Scrum values: commitment, focus, openness and respect, and courage.
You thrive in a team environment and are happy to share your knowledge and insights
You have excellent communication skills: your messages are well-structured, both orally and in writing, and you adapt easily to your audience
You are proficient in English; in addition, knowledge of Dutch or French is definitely a plus
You will delight us if you can show one of the following:
Practical knowledge of APIs, Java-based distributed applications, Mainframe programs, SQL queries and data manipulation
Experience with software testing and testing tools
Notions of data management and software life cycle management
Working experience in an Agile environment
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER
Our impact
We strongly believe in the positive impact that the financial sector can have on the world. BNP?Paribas?Fortis offers sustainable and responsible investment products and solutions and encourages social entrepreneurship. Together with our customers, we are working towards a better future every day.
Your career perspectives
Throughout your career at BNP Paribas Fortis, you will benefit from the personal support of a career advisor who will help you define your skills and prospects for the future.
Our offer
In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalised benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).
Our engagement
In a changing world,
diversity and inclusion
are core values in our pursuit of wellbeing and optimal performance for all our teams. At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to welcome and retain talented people of all kinds, regardless of gender, age, origin or sexual orientation and of whether or not they live with a disability, as each person has their own experiences and identity to contribute. Together, we are building the bank of tomorrow: innovative, responsible and sustainable. All our full-time posts are also open to candidates wishing to work on an 80% or 90% full-time equivalent basis.
If the function is categorized as a banking services provider function (cf. Law of 22 April 2019 establishing an oath and a disciplinary regime for the banking sector), you will also need to provide us with a 'certificate of absence of professional ban' from the FSMA confirming that you are not professionally disqualified.
